Holding equities across different industries, sectors, and geographies at a given time

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 42 defines cross-sectional diversification as holding equities across different industries, sectors, and geographies at a given time. The Trap: Time diversification is a separate concept covering holding period rather than breadth across sectors. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 42.
